reasons: Both answers correct the premise at the start (no approval means the 综合工时 clause has no effect, and signing does not waive overtime pay). Both also state that 1 to 3 October is 300% even with an approval, and both reach 3,724.14 + 3,310.34 = 7,034.48 yuan. I recomputed the arithmetic: 9000/21.75 = 413.79, and every figure checks out in both answers. A cites 人社部发〔2025〕2号 for 21.75, as the key does. It is much tighter and carries fewer unverifiable source claims, though it skips the 9/20 and 10/10 working days and the free-arbitration and verify-the-approval steps. B covers more of the key: the 补班日, asking the company to show the approval, free arbitration, and the explanation that the 300% is paid on top of the 9,000 yuan. But it is roughly twice as long, repeats itself (a second cross-check, a sixth section of variables, an offer to draft a letter) and adds many hard-to-verify citations and quotes. Coverage and concision roughly cancel out, so A wins slightly on concision and honesty. I judged the unverified claims from my own knowledge and did not open any links.
